p.x: The WebGLRenderer instance that owns this WebGLShaderSetterWrapper.

m.x: A lookup table keyed by WebGL type constant (hex value) that maps eachGLSL data type to its uniform setter functions, component count, bytesize per component, and a flag indicating whether the type is a matrix.Used when uploading uniform values to a shader program so the correctWebGL call is chosen automatically for each uniform's declared type.
